notes:
**CHR-1257, Stitch Mockups tab (2026-11-27, awaiting Christian's approval).** The CHR-1260 B1 model on the Stitch mockups canvas: three variant columns float on the dotted workspace (frames `radius.frame` + `shadow-frame`, no border), the Mockups tab of the nav card selects `cart-summary-options`.
- **Tool bar:** only Comment (C → `mockup-comments-mode`) and Comments (M, `pressed`; → `chrome-c-mockup-columns`) are enabled. Inspect, Notes, Flow and Design system are `disabled`, each label says why (they work on screens only).
- **Right column:** Agent bar folded (`agent-bar-folded`, Idle) above the Comments card, as for every tool panel. The card's scope reads "3 variants"; Open / Resolved `seg-tabs` (Resolved → `mockup-comments-resolved`); one `comment-thread-row` per thread with the variant letter after the node ("a-item-1 (A)"), `selected` for the open one. A row opens its pin's popover; the detached row (`thread-5`) → `mockup-comments-detached`.
- The floating `comment-toolbar` and the Context row (`comments-count-row`) of CHR-1260 are gone; their jobs moved to the two tools and the card.

---
**Mockup comments: thread open in a column** (CHR-1260 / CHR-1261, direction B1). The canvas comment model, applied unchanged to the mockup column view.

**Layout:** each variant is a column: a `mockup-column-header` (`variant-badge` letter, title, description, count chips) above the frame. Chips per column: `comment-count-chip` open / `detached` / `resolved` (the last only while Show resolved is on).

**Pins:** `comment-pin` centred on the anchored element's top-right corner, inside its variant's frame. Detached pins sit at the frame's top-left. **Thread numbers run across the whole mockup** (#1–#5), not per variant, so "#3" is unique in a discussion. The anchor is `mockup:<mockup>#<variant>.<node-id>` (format owned by the architect).

**Popover:** the same `comment-popover` as on a screen (reply composer, Resolve, ⋯, close). The title carries the `variant-badge` after the number ("#1 A"), so the variant reads without looking at the column. It opens to the right of the pin and may overlap the neighbouring column. It flips left at the stage edge (see `mockup-comments-resolved`) and below when that would cover another pin (see `mockup-comments-detached`).

**Behaviour:** a click on a pin opens its thread. One popover at a time. Esc, close or a click outside closes it. The Comment tool or `C` enters comment mode (→ `mockup-comments-mode`).

**Implementation and a11y:** the same as the canvas. Pins are buttons in DOM order column by column (A → B → C), with aria-label "Comment N on <variant letter>, <node>, <status>" and `aria-expanded`. The popover is `popover="auto"` + `role="dialog"`; focus goes to the composer on open and returns to the pin on close. Anchor positioning uses `position-area: inline-end span-block-end` + `position-try-fallbacks: flip-inline, flip-block`, gated in `@supports (position-area: block-end)`, with a JS getBoundingClientRect fallback.

The frames' inner HTML stands in for the mockup's own raw HTML (outside the ref model). Its literal values are intentional, so the drift and repeated-pattern warnings on `*-frame`, `*-item-*`, `*-total-row` and `*-btn-checkout` are expected.
